title: Canonical - Vesting Event Transaction
description: Canonical (hypothetical OCF) representation of an event-firing transaction. Witnesses that a named vesting event has fired for a given security on a given date. Any VestingStatement whose `vesting_base.type` is `EVENT` and whose `event_id` matches this transaction's `event_id` resolves its anchor at this firing. The witness is canonical's runtime input for non-deterministic triggers, symmetric with TX_CANONICAL_VESTING_START for date anchors.

security_id.description: Identifier of the security whose VestingStatement(s) reference this event. The firing is scoped to a single security; cross-grant fan-out of one underlying event is represented by emitting one transaction per affected security.

event_id.description: Identifier of the named event that fired. Matches `event_id` on a `VestingBaseEvent` of some VestingStatement on this security's template.

realized_fraction.description: Optional. Fraction of each matching statement's maximum amount that actually vested. Absent means binary firing (the full max amount vests). Present means partial payout — e.g., for performance grants where achievement scales with a metric. Carta's `PerformanceCondition.payoutPercentage` projects onto this field.
